# 147c829e79fb322f (shadowmap_pbr.bfsha variant 641, vertex): inputs 1-5 only move bits (in a loop: x bit-cast to int, y copied as a float), so dmsh_build.py's integer-input guess declared them uint4;
# the game feeds them 16-bit normalized formats (RG16 / RG16_SNORM), which Maxwell converts to floats and Metal will not pair with an integer input. The pipeline failed, and with it the foliage's
